text: Frenzy [Gr. frenhsiV , inflammation of the brain]: Ger. Raserei ; Fr. fièvre chaude (popular), manie aiguë (scientific); Ital. frenesia . An agitation of the brain, which renders the individual temporarily delirious or deranged. It is used mainly in a popular sense for extreme maniacal excitement, aroused perhaps by anger, passion, and the like; but it also retains an older usage, in which it is regarded as equivalent to a temporary madness or derangement. ( J.J. )
